findings.title: getGroupIdsWithViewPermission uses authz resource ID instead of group ID
findings.body: GroupPermissionsV2.getGroupIdsWithViewPermission() iterates resources of type Groups and calls hasPermission(groupResource.getId(),...) then does granted.add(groupResource.getId()). In V2 the authz Resource name is the group ID (see AdminPermissionsSchema.resolveGroup/getOrCreateResource) and the Resource ID is a generated UUID. Passing the UUID to hasPermission() makes findByName(server, groupId) miss and fall back to the all-groups resource, and the returned set contains UUIDs not group IDs. Consumers like UsersResource.getUsersCount() and searchForUser() pass this set as group IDs to filter users, so per-group view-members/manage-members permissions will return empty/wrong user lists and counts, or grant all groups if an all-groups policy exists.

findings.title: Global canManage() granted by view-only group permission
findings.body: GroupPermissionsV2.canManage() returns true if hasPermission(null, VIEW, MANAGE) succeeds. That means holding only the view scope on the all-groups resource grants global manage, which is checked by GroupsResource.addTopLevelGroup() via requireManage() for creating top-level groups and other manage operations. Per-group canManage(GroupModel) correctly requires only MANAGE, and UserPermissions global canManage requires only manage. View must not imply manage; the check should be for MANAGE only.

findings.title: V2 group permission management throws and breaks group deletion cleanup
findings.body: GroupPermissionsV2 overrides setPermissionsEnabled/isPermissionsEnabled/resource/getPermissions to throw UnsupportedOperationException. MgmtPermissionsV2.groups() now returns this class, so AdminPermissions.registerListener() on GroupModel.GroupRemovedEvent which calls management(...).groups().setPermissionsEnabled(group,false) will throw for any realm with ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ_V2 enabled, aborting group removal. V2 still creates per-group Resources that need cleanup on deletion, so the method cannot unconditionally throw.
